I pushed `fix-data-safety` and opened PR 1: https://github.com/meirka8/twin/pull/39

It targets `main` and has both commits, so the roadmap is part of the PR too. Tests passed again just before the push.

The description lists the four Critical bugs and how each could lose data, explains how copy and move work now, and names the known gaps for the next PRs. The main gap is that refused copies don't show a message yet.

One item in the PR's test plan is still unticked: a manual check in the TUI, because I only tested through `Update`, not by hand. Worth trying before you merge: delete or copy with the cursor on `..`, copy with both panes on the same directory, and a batch where you answer some conflicts `n` and some `y`.
